github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Write a single-line conventional commit message: 'type(scope): short summary', max 50 characters. Scope is the area changed, e.g. theme, ui, nav, home, form, settings, i18n, deps. Prefer a subject line alone. If the subject cannot capture the change, add a blank line and a short body (1-2 lines wrapped at 50 characters) explaining what and why. Types: feat, fix, refac, chore, test, docs.
